title: orthosiphon thymiflorus var. viscosus
intro: Orthosiphon thymiflorus var. viscosus, commonly known as Uva Ursi, is a plant species in the mint family native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the treatment of urinary tract infections, due to its diuretic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Uva Ursi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant has also been studied for its potential in preventing kidney stones and reducing oxidative stress.
